title: MTOR: Generalizable AI-Generated Video Detection with Multimodal Semantics and Temporal Over-Regularity
title_zh: MTOR：基于多模态语义与时间过度规律性的通用化AI生成视频检测

paragraphs.en: The rapid evolution of video generation has narrowed the perceptual gap between authentic and synthetic videos, making generalizable AI-generated video detection increasingly challenging. Existing detectors predominantly rely on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics underexplored. Meanwhile, temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations has received limited attention. We find that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations. Our analysis further reveals that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and lower temporal variability, a pattern we term temporal over-regularity (TOR). Based on these findings, we propose MTOR with a multimodal branch and a TOR component. The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, while the TOR component models temporal over-regularity at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. Extensive evaluations on five benchmarks covering 46 generator variants demonstrate state-of-the-art overall performance against 16 representative baselines, while robustness experiments confirm strong resilience to twelve real-world video perturbations. paragraphs.en: The rapid evolution of generative artificial intelligence has spurred unprecedented breakthroughs in video synthesis. Driven by scaling laws and advanced diffusion-based architectures, state-of-the-art video generation frameworks such as Sora [ 1 ] , Runway Gen-4 [ 2 ] and Kling [ 3 ] are capable of producing high-fidelity videos with photorealistic visual quality, fluent motion, and coherent spatiotemporal scenes. These advances have made AI-generated videos increasingly difficult to visually distinguish from authentic videos. Meanwhile, the widespread availability of these sophisticated generation techniques brings severe societal risks. Maliciously fabricated videos can easily propagate misinformation [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ] , undermine public trust [ 11 , 12 ] in digital media, and even pose potential ethical and security threats. Consequently, developing a generalizable detection paradigm to identify AI-generated videos has become increasingly important for advancing multimedia forensics and safeguarding societal trust.
paragraphs.zh: 生成式人工智能的快速发展推动了视频合成领域的突破性进展。 在扩展定律和先进的扩散模型架构的驱动下，诸如 Sora [ 1 ]、Runway Gen-4 [ 2 ] 和 Kling [ 3 ] 等顶尖的视频生成框架能够产出具有照片级真实视觉质量、流畅动作以及连贯时空场景的高保真视频。 这些进步使得人工智能生成的视频在视觉上越来越难以与真实视频区分。 与此同时，这些复杂生成技术的广泛普及也带来了严重的社会风险。 恶意伪造的视频可能轻易传播虚假信息 [ 4 , 5 , 6 , 7 , 8 , 9 , 10 ]、削弱公众对数字媒体的信任 [ 11 , 12 ]，甚至引发潜在的伦理和安全威胁。 因此，开发一种可泛化的检测范式以识别人工智能生成的视频，对于推动多媒体法证研究并维护社会信任变得日益重要。

paragraphs.en: To mitigate these threats, recent studies have explored diverse temporal and spatiotemporal modeling strategies for AI-generated video detection. DeCoF [ 13 ] focuses on inter-frame consistency to capture temporal artifacts that generalize across generators, while ReStraV [ 14 ] analyzes the geometry of visual representation trajectories through temporal curvature and distance. D3 [ 15 ] further characterizes second-order temporal variation, whereas NSG-VD [ 16 ] models spatiotemporal dynamics through conservation constraints on probability flow. STALL [ 17 ] takes a probabilistic perspective by jointly modeling spatial likelihoods of individual frames and temporal likelihoods of inter-frame transitions. Despite these advances, most existing approaches base their predictions primarily on visual representations, leaving caption-derived textual semantics largely unexplored. Such reliance on visual representations may overlook complementary discriminative cues conveyed by caption-derived textual semantics. Meanwhile, existing temporal and spatiotemporal methods characterize video dynamics from diverse perspectives, yet the temporal regularities encoded in fine-grained visual representations have not been fully exploited for generalizable detection.
paragraphs.zh: 为缓解这些威胁，近期研究探索了多种时间性和时空建模策略，用于检测人工智能生成的视频。 DeCoF [ 13 ] 专注于帧间一致性，以捕捉跨生成器具有普适性的时间性伪影；而 ReStraV [ 14 ] 则通过时间曲率和距离分析视觉表示轨迹的几何特性。 D3 [ 15 ] 进一步刻画了二阶时间变化，而 NSG-VD [ 16 ] 则通过概率流的守恒约束来建模时空动态。 STALL [ 17 ] 从概率视角出发，联合建模单帧的空间可能性与帧间转换的时间性可能性。 尽管取得了这些进展，大多数现有方法仍主要基于视觉表示进行预测，而标题派生的文本语义则基本未被探索。 这种对视觉表示的依赖可能会忽视标题派生文本语义所传递的互补性判别线索。 与此同时，现有的时间和时空方法虽从不同视角刻画了视频动态，但精细视觉表示中编码的时间规律尚未被充分用于实现普适性的检测。

paragraphs.en: To address these limitations, we investigate AI-generated video detection from two complementary perspectives: video-level multimodal semantics and fine-grained temporal regularity. First, we examine the contribution of caption-derived textual representations when combined with global visual representations. Our empirical results show that their combination consistently outperforms either representation alone, indicating that caption-derived semantics provide discriminative cues complementary to visual representations. Second, we analyze fine-grained visual dynamics at three levels: coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. Across these levels, AI-generated videos consistently exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability than real-world videos. We term this tendency temporal over-regularity (TOR).
paragraphs.zh: 为了解决这些局限性，我们从两个互补的视角研究人工智能生成的视频检测问题：视频级多模态语义和精细时间规律性。 首先，我们考察了与全局视觉表示结合时，源自字幕的文本表示所做出的贡献。 我们的实证结果表明，将两者结合使用始终优于单独使用任一表示方式，这说明源自字幕的语义提供了与视觉表示互补的区分性线索。 其次，我们从三个层面分析了精细的视觉动态：粗略的帧间连续性、精细的标记对应性以及帧到视频的稳定性。 在这些各个层面，人工智能生成的视频始终表现出比真实世界视频更强的时间持续性和更低的时间变异性。 我们将这种倾向称为时间过度规律性（TOR）。

paragraphs.en: Based on these observations, we propose MTOR , a multimodal AI-generated video detector that jointly models video-level M ultimodal semantics and T emporal O ver- R egularity. Given an input video, a video encoder extracts a global visual representation, while a video captioning model generates a textual description that is subsequently encoded into a global textual representation. The multimodal branch combines the visual and textual representations to produce a multimodal detection score. In parallel, the TOR component explicitly models the three levels of temporal regularity using six descriptors that capture the strength and variation of adjacent-frame relations, together with the stability of frame-to-video similarity. These descriptors are subsequently mapped to a TOR detection score. Finally, the multimodal and TOR scores are standardized using statistics estimated from the source-training set and fused to obtain the final MTOR score, without requiring any target-domain data.
paragraphs.zh: 基于这些观察，我们提出了 MTOR——一种多模态 AI 生成视频检测器，它联合建模了视频级别的多模态语义和时序规律性。 给定一个输入视频，视频编码器会提取全局视觉表示，而视频描述模型则会生成文本描述，该描述随后被编码为全局文本表示。 多模态分支将视觉表示和文本表示相结合，以生成多模态检测得分。 与此同时，TOR 组件使用六个描述符显式建模三种层级的时序规律性，这些描述符捕捉了相邻帧关系的强度和变化，以及帧与视频相似性的稳定性。 这些描述符随后被映射到一个 TOR 检测得分。 最后，多模态得分和 TOR 得分使用从源训练集估计的统计量进行标准化，并融合以获得最终的 MTOR 得分，而无需任何目标域数据。

paragraphs.en: Deepfake video detection has gradually shifted from frame-level artifact analysis toward exploiting temporal and spatiotemporal inconsistencies across video frames. Early video-based methods therefore focused on exposing inter-frame inconsistencies. STIL [ 18 ] integrates spatial inconsistencies with adjacent-frame temporal differences, while FTCN [ 19 ] suppresses spatial modeling to emphasize temporal features and captures long-range temporal coherence with a Temporal Transformer. Subsequent studies further model temporal dependencies over multiple ranges. MRE-Net [ 20 ] employs multi-rate sampling to capture short- and long-term spatiotemporal inconsistencies, whereas ISTVT [ 21 ] decomposes self-attention into spatial and temporal dimensions and emphasizes inter-frame temporal inconsistencies. TALL [ 22 ] rearranges consecutive frames into a compact thumbnail for efficient spatiotemporal modeling, while MINTIME [ 23 ] introduces identity-aware modeling for videos containing multiple identities and varying face sizes.
paragraphs.zh: 深度伪造视频检测已逐渐从帧级伪影分析转向利用视频帧之间的时序和时空不一致性。 因此，早期的基于视频的方法主要集中在揭示帧间的不一致性上。 STIL [ 18 ] 将空间不一致性与相邻帧的时序差异相结合，而 FTCN [ 19 ] 则抑制空间建模以强调时序特征，并通过时序 Transformer 捕捉长程时序连贯性。 后续研究进一步对多个范围上的时序依赖关系进行了建模。 MRE-Net [ 20 ] 采用多速率采样来捕捉短期和长期的时空不一致性，而 ISTVT [ 21 ] 则将自注意力分解为空间和时间维度，并强调帧间的时间不一致性。 TALL [ 22 ] 将连续帧重新排列为一个紧凑的缩略图，以实现高效的时空建模；而 MINTIME [ 23 ] 则针对包含多个身份和不同面部尺寸的视频引入了身份感知建模方法。

paragraphs.en: As deepfake generation techniques become increasingly realistic, improving generalization to unseen manipulations has received growing attention. AltFreezing [ 24 ] alternately freezes spatial- and temporal-related weights to prevent excessive reliance on either artifact type, while DIP [ 25 ] models directional spatiotemporal inconsistencies and introduces generalization-oriented training strategies. Beyond conventional RGB-level temporal cues, StyleFlow [ 26 ] analyzes temporal variations of facial style latent vectors, and recent work [ 27 ] extends temporal analysis to the frequency domain. Yan et al. [ 28 ] identify Facial Feature Drift as a transferable temporal forgery artifact and construct hard negative samples through video-level blending, whereas FakeSTormer [ 29 ] introduces auxiliary spatial and temporal vulnerability branches to improve generalization and interpretability. Collectively, these studies seek more transferable temporal representations and learning strategies for generalized deepfake detection.
paragraphs.zh: 随着深度伪造生成技术变得越来越逼真，提升模型对未见过的伪造手段的泛化能力已受到越来越多的关注。 AltFreezing [ 24 ] 交替冻结空间相关和时间相关的权重，以防止过度依赖某一种伪造痕迹；而 DIP [ 25 ] 则建模了方向性的时空不一致性，并引入了面向泛化的训练策略。 除了传统的 RGB 层面的时间线索外，StyleFlow [ 26 ] 分析了面部风格潜在向量的时间变化，而近期的研究 [ 27 ] 将时间分析扩展到了频率域。Yan 等人 [ 28 ] 将“面部特征漂移”识别为一种可迁移的时间伪造痕迹，并通过视频级混合构建困难负样本；而 FakeSTormer [ 29 ] 则引入了辅助的空间和时间脆弱性分支，以提升泛化能力和可解释性。 总体而言，这些研究旨在寻找更具迁移性的时间表示和更有效的学习策略，以实现深度伪造的通用检测。

paragraphs.en: Multimodal cues have also been investigated for deepfake video detection. Feng et al. [ 30 ] formulate video forensics as self-supervised anomaly detection based on audio-visual synchronization, while AVFF [ 9 ] learns audio-visual correspondences through self-supervised contrastive and reconstruction objectives before supervised fine-tuning. These studies demonstrate that inconsistencies in audio-visual synchronization and correspondence can help distinguish manipulated from authentic videos. Nevertheless, most deepfake video detectors are designed for facial manipulation and primarily exploit face-specific spatial, temporal, or audio-visual cues. Their problem setting therefore differs from open-domain AI-generated video detection, where entire videos may be synthesized by diverse generation models and span a wide range of scenes, objects, actions, and motion patterns.
paragraphs.zh: 多模态线索也被用于深度伪造视频的检测研究。Feng 等人 [ 30 ] 将视频取证问题表述为基于视听同步的自监督异常检测，而 AVFF [ 9 ] 则通过自监督对比学习和重建目标学习视听对应关系，再进行有监督微调。 这些研究表明，视听同步和对应关系中的不一致性有助于区分被篡改的视频与真实视频。 然而，大多数深度伪造视频检测器都是针对面部篡改设计的，主要利用面部特有的空间、时间或视听线索。 因此，它们的问题设定不同于开放领域的 AI 生成视频检测：在后者中，整个视频可能由多种生成模型合成，并涵盖广泛场景、物体、动作和运动模式。

paragraphs.en: Unlike deepfake detection, which primarily targets facial manipulation, AI-generated video detection addresses fully synthesized videos beyond the facial domain, making generalization to unseen video generators particularly challenging. Early studies approached this problem by modeling spatial and temporal artifacts in generated videos. AIGVDet [ 31 ] employs separate RGB and optical-flow branches to capture spatial abnormalities and temporal inconsistencies, respectively, and combines their frame-level predictions through decision-level fusion for video-level detection. DeMamba [ 32 ] further models local spatiotemporal inconsistencies across different regions using a structured state-space model. However, spatial artifacts are often generator-specific. Motivated by this observation, DeCoF [ 13 ] reduces the influence of spatial artifacts during feature learning and focuses on inter-frame consistency to improve generalization to unseen generators. Together, these studies highlight spatial and temporal artifacts as important forensic cues for AI-generated video detection.
paragraphs.zh: 与主要针对面部篡改的深度伪造检测不同，AI生成视频检测需要处理超出面部领域的完全合成的视频，这使得对未见过的视频生成器的泛化变得尤为困难。 早期研究通过建模生成视频中的空间和时间伪影来解决这一问题。 AIGVDet [ 31 ] 采用独立的RGB和光流分支分别捕捉空间异常和时间不一致性，并通过决策级融合将它们的帧级预测结合，以实现视频级检测。 DeMamba [ 32 ] 进一步利用结构化状态空间模型来建模不同区域之间的局部时空不一致性。 然而，空间伪影通常与特定的生成器相关。 基于这一观察，DeCoF [ 13 ] 在特征学习过程中降低了空间伪影的影响，并专注于帧间一致性，以改善对未见生成器的泛化能力。 综合来看，这些研究凸显了空间和时间伪影作为AI生成视频检测的重要数字取证线索。

paragraphs.en: More recent studies have examined video dynamics from increasingly diverse perspectives. ReStraV [ 14 ] analyzes frame trajectories in a pretrained visual representation space and characterizes their geometry through temporal curvature and stepwise distance. D3 [ 15 ] derives second-order temporal features from first-order inter-frame differences and performs training-free detection using statistics of second-order central differences. In a different direction, NSG-VD [ 16 ] takes a physics-driven approach to modeling spatiotemporal video evolution through conservation constraints on probability flow. It defines the Normalized Spatiotemporal Gradient (NSG) as the ratio of spatial probability gradients to temporal density changes, and detects AI-generated videos by comparing NSG distributions between test and real videos. STALL [ 17 ] adopts a training-free probabilistic framework that jointly models the spatial likelihood of individual frames and the temporal likelihood of frame-to-frame transitions.
paragraphs.zh: 近期的研究从日益多样化的视角探讨了视频动态。 ReStraV [ 14 ] 在预训练的视觉表示空间中分析帧轨迹，并通过时间曲率和分步距离来描述其几何特性。 D3 [ 15 ] 从一阶帧间差异中推导出二阶时间特征，并利用二阶中心差的统计量进行无需训练的检测。 在另一个方向上，NSG-VD [ 16 ] 采用了一种基于物理的方法，通过概率流的守恒约束来建模时空视频演化。 它将归一化时空梯度（NSG）定义为空间概率梯度与时间密度变化之比，并通过比较测试视频和真实视频之间的 NSG 分布来检测人工智能生成的视频。 STALL [ 17 ] 采用了一种无需训练的概率框架，该框架联合建模了单帧的空间可能性以及帧间转换的时间可能性。

In contrast, MTOR extends beyond purely visual formulations by incorporating a caption-derived textual representation of the same video. It further characterizes temporal over-regularity through coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability.

paragraphs.en: This section presents the empirical observations underlying the design of MTOR. We first examine video-level visual and caption-derived textual representations for AI-generated video detection and show that combining the two improves detection over either representation alone. We then analyze temporal dynamics reflected in fine-grained visual representations and observe that AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability, a tendency we term temporal over-regularity (TOR). Finally, experiments across five benchmarks show that TOR complements the video-level multimodal representation, motivating the joint modeling of multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity in MTOR.
paragraphs.zh: 本节介绍了 MTOR 设计所依据的经验性观察结果。 我们首先研究了视频级别的视觉表示和从字幕中提取的文本表示，用于检测人工智能生成的视频，并发现将两者结合使用比单独使用任一表示都能提升检测效果。 接着，我们分析了精细视觉表示中反映的时间动态特征，观察到人工智能生成的视频表现出更强的时间持续性和更低的时间变异性，我们将这一倾向称为“时间过度规则性”（TOR）。 最后，在五个基准数据集上进行的实验表明，TOR 能够补充视频级别的多模态表示，这促使我们在 MTOR 中联合建模多模态语义和时间过度规则性。

paragraphs.en: To examine the effectiveness of different video-level representations for AI-generated video detection, we evaluate three variants: visual-only, text-only, and a multimodal variant G G that combines the two representations. Given an input video 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , a pretrained video encoder extracts its global visual representation, which is used by the visual-only variant for authenticity classification. As reported in Table I , this variant achieves 97.42% AP and 97.04% AUC on GenVideo.
paragraphs.zh: 为了检验不同视频级表示在人工智能生成视频检测中的有效性，我们评估了三种变体：仅视觉、仅文本以及结合这两种表示的多模态变体 G G。 给定输入视频 𝒱 \mathcal{V}，预训练的视频编码器会提取其全局视觉表示，该表示被仅视觉变体用于真实性分类。 如表 I 所示，该变体在 GenVideo 数据集上实现了 97.42% 的 AP 和 97.04% 的 AUC。

sents.en: To examine the effectiveness of different video-level representations for AI-generated video detection, we evaluate three variants: visual-only, text-only, and a multimodal variant G G that combines the two representations.
sents.zh: 为了检验不同视频级表示在人工智能生成视频检测中的有效性，我们评估了三种变体：仅视觉、仅文本以及结合这两种表示的多模态变体 G G。

sents.en: Given an input video 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , a pretrained video encoder extracts its global visual representation, which is used by the visual-only variant for authenticity classification.
sents.zh: 给定输入视频 𝒱 \mathcal{V}，预训练的视频编码器会提取其全局视觉表示，该表示被仅视觉变体用于真实性分类。

sents.en: As reported in Table I , this variant achieves 97.42% AP and 97.04% AUC on GenVideo.
sents.zh: 如表 I 所示，该变体在 GenVideo 数据集上实现了 97.42% 的 AP 和 97.04% 的 AUC。

paragraphs.en: We next examine the caption-derived textual representation. A video captioning model generates a textual description from the same input video, which is subsequently encoded into a video-level textual representation. Since the caption is generated directly from 𝒱 \mathcal{V} , no external textual input is required. As shown in Table I , the text-only variant achieves 93.18 % 93.18\% AP and 92.81 % 92.81\% AUC.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们研究从字幕中推导出的文本表示。 视频字幕模型从相同的输入视频中生成文本描述，随后该描述被编码为视频级别的文本表示。 由于字幕是直接从 𝒱 \mathcal{V} 生成的，因此不需要任何外部文本输入。 如表 I 所示，仅使用文本的变体实现了 93.18 % 93.18\% AP 和 92.81 % 92.81\% AUC。

sents.en: We next examine the caption-derived textual representation.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们研究从字幕中推导出的文本表示。

sents.zh: 如表 I 所示，仅使用文本的变体实现了 93.18 % 93.18\% AP 和 92.81 % 92.81\% AUC。

paragraphs.en: Although both representations are derived from the same video, they encode the video from different perspectives. The visual representation encodes global spatiotemporal information, whereas the caption-derived textual representation summarizes high-level semantics such as objects, actions, attributes, and their relations. Combining the two increases AP from 97.42 % 97.42\% to 98.81 % 98.81\% , AUC from 97.04 % 97.04\% to 98.66 % 98.66\% , and ACC from 90.30 % 90.30\% to 93.80 % 93.80\% . These gains indicate that caption-derived textual representations provide complementary discriminative cues to global visual representations. Accordingly, MTOR jointly models the two representations in its video-level multimodal branch G G , while fine-grained temporal dynamics are investigated next.
paragraphs.zh: 尽管这两种表示都源自同一视频，但它们从不同视角对视频进行了编码。 视觉表示编码了全局的时空信息，而源自字幕的文本表示则总结了物体、动作、属性及其关系等高层语义。 将两者结合后，AP 从 97.42 % 97.42\% 提升至 98.81 % 98.81\%，AUC 从 97.04 % 97.04\% 提升至 98.66 % 98.66\%，ACC 则从 90.30 % 90.30\% 提升至 93.80 % 93.80\%。 这些提升表明，源自字幕的文本表示为全局视觉表示提供了互补的区分性线索。 因此，MTOR 在其视频级多模态分支 G G 中联合建模了这两种表示，而细粒度时间动态将在下一部分进行探讨。

paragraphs.en: To investigate temporal regularity in fine-grained visual representations, we analyze visual tokens at three levels, as illustrated in Fig. 1 (a): coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. Each level is characterized by statistics reflecting temporal persistence and variability. Fig. 1 (b)–(d) visualize the distributions of real and AI-generated videos under these analyses. Across all three levels, AI-generated videos exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability than real videos.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究精细视觉表示中的时间规律性，我们分析了三个层级的视觉标记，如图 1 (a) 所示：粗略的帧间连续性、精细的标记对应性以及帧到视频的整体稳定性。 每个层级都由反映时间持续性和可变性的统计数据来描述。 图 1 (b)–(d) 展示了在这些分析下真实视频和 AI 生成视频的分布情况。 在所有三个层级中，AI 生成的视频都比真实视频表现出更强的时间持续性和更低的时间可变性。

sents.zh: 为了研究精细视觉表示中的时间规律性，我们分析了三个层级的视觉标记，如图 1 (a) 所示：粗略的帧间连续性、精细的标记对应性以及帧到视频的整体稳定性。

paragraphs.en: Coarse Inter-frame Continuity: We average the visual tokens within each frame to obtain a frame centroid and compute the cosine similarity between consecutive frame centroids. Fig. 1 (b) plots the temporal mean of adjacent-centroid similarity against its standard deviation. AI-generated videos exhibit higher mean similarity and lower temporal variation, indicating stronger inter-frame continuity.
paragraphs.zh: 粗略的帧间连续性：我们对每一帧内的视觉标记取平均，得到帧中心点，并计算连续帧中心点之间的余弦相似度。 图 1 (b) 绘制了相邻中心点相似度的时间均值与其标准偏差的关系。 AI 生成的视频表现出更高的平均相似度和更低的时间变化性，表明其帧间连续性更强。

sents.en: Coarse Inter-frame Continuity: We average the visual tokens within each frame to obtain a frame centroid and compute the cosine similarity between consecutive frame centroids.
sents.zh: 粗略的帧间连续性：我们对每一帧内的视觉标记取平均，得到帧中心点，并计算连续帧中心点之间的余弦相似度。

sents.en: AI-generated videos exhibit higher mean similarity and lower temporal variation, indicating stronger inter-frame continuity.
sents.zh: AI 生成的视频表现出更高的平均相似度和更低的时间变化性，表明其帧间连续性更强。

paragraphs.en: Fine-grained Token Correspondence: We compare visual tokens between consecutive frames to characterize fine-grained temporal correspondence. For each pair of adjacent frames, each token is matched to its most similar counterpart in the other frame, and the resulting similarities are aggregated into an adjacent-token correspondence score. Fig. 1 (c) shows that AI-generated videos exhibit higher mean correspondence and lower temporal variation, indicating stronger and more stable token correspondence across consecutive frames.
paragraphs.zh: 细粒度令牌对应关系：我们比较连续帧之间的视觉令牌，以描述细粒度的时间对应关系。 对于每一对相邻帧，每个令牌都会被匹配到另一帧中最相似的对应项，并将由此得到的相似性汇总为相邻令牌对应分数。 图 1 (c) 显示，人工智能生成的视频表现出更高的平均对应性和更低的时间变化性，表明其在连续帧之间具有更强且更稳定的令牌对应关系。

sents.zh: 细粒度令牌对应关系：我们比较连续帧之间的视觉令牌，以描述细粒度的时间对应关系。

paragraphs.en: Frame-to-video Stability: To characterize temporal regularity over a broader context, we compare the visual tokens of each frame with those from the remaining frames in the video, yielding a frame-to-video similarity. Fig. 1 (d) characterizes the temporal variation of these similarities. AI-generated videos exhibit lower variation and smaller temporal changes, indicating more stable frame-to-video relations over time.
paragraphs.zh: 帧到视频稳定性：为了在更广泛的情境中描述时间上的规律性，我们将每一帧的视觉标记与视频中其余帧的视觉标记进行比较，从而得到帧到视频的相似性。 图 1 (d) 描述了这些相似性的时间变化。 AI 生成的视频表现出更小的变化和更少的时间波动，表明其帧到视频的关系在时间上更为稳定。

sents.en: Frame-to-video Stability: To characterize temporal regularity over a broader context, we compare the visual tokens of each frame with those from the remaining frames in the video, yielding a frame-to-video similarity.
sents.zh: 帧到视频稳定性：为了在更广泛的情境中描述时间上的规律性，我们将每一帧的视觉标记与视频中其余帧的视觉标记进行比较，从而得到帧到视频的相似性。

paragraphs.en: Collectively, these three analyses reveal a consistent temporal tendency in AI-generated videos, characterized by stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability. We term this tendency temporal over-regularity (TOR), which motivates the TOR component for AI-generated video detection.
paragraphs.zh: 综合来看，这三项分析揭示了人工智能生成视频中存在一种一致的时间趋势，其特点是时间持续性更强，时间可变性更低。 我们将这种趋势称为“时间过度规律性”（TOR），这也催生了用于检测人工智能生成视频的 TOR 组件。

sents.en: We term this tendency temporal over-regularity (TOR), which motivates the TOR component for AI-generated video detection.

The multimodal representation captures global visual and caption-derived semantics, whereas TOR characterizes temporal over-regularity reflected in fine-grained visual dynamics. We therefore examine whether the two provide complementary cues for AI-generated video detection.

paragraphs.en: Table II reports the mean performance across five benchmarks: GenVideo, EvalCrafter, VideoPhy, VidProM, and GenVidBench. By combining these two predictions, MTOR improves performance to 97.76% AP, 97.92% AUC, and 90.24% ACC. These gains indicate that temporal over-regularity provides discriminative cues beyond the global multimodal representation.

paragraphs.en: Motivated by the empirical observations in Sec. III , MTOR jointly models video-level multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity for AI-generated video detection. The multimodal branch integrates global visual and caption-derived textual representations, whereas the TOR component models temporal over-regularity through coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. The two components produce complementary detection scores, which are calibrated using source-training statistics and subsequently fused to obtain the final MTOR score.

paragraphs.en: GenVideo [ 32 ] : Comprises 10 distinct test subsets spanning a diverse range of generative architectures, specifically featuring Gen2 [ 40 ] , Sora [ 1 ] , ModelScope (MS) [ 41 ] , MoonValley (MV) [ 42 ] , MorphStudio (MPS) [ 43 ] , Show-1 [ 44 ] , HotShot [ 45 ] , LaVie [ 46 ] , Crafter [ 47 ] , and WildScrape (WS) [ 48 , 49 , 50 ] .
paragraphs.zh: GenVideo [ 32 ]：包含 10 个独立的测试子集，涵盖了多种生成架构，具体包括 Gen2 [ 40 ]、Sora [ 1 ]、ModelScope (MS) [ 41 ]、MoonValley (MV) [ 42 ]、MorphStudio (MPS) [ 43 ]、Show-1 [ 44 ]、HotShot [ 45 ]、LaVie [ 46 ]、Crafter [ 47 ] 以及 WildScrape (WS) [ 48 , 49 , 50 ]。

paragraphs.en: EvalCrafter [ 33 ] : Features 14 video generator subsets, namely VideoCrafter V0.9 (Floor33), MoonValley (MV), Gen2, Gen2-December (Gen2-D), Mix-SR, HotShot-XL (HS-XL), Show-1, ModelScope (MS), LaVie-Base (LaVie-B), LaVie-Interpolation (LaVie-I), PikaLab (PKL), VideoCrafter (VC), PikaLab V1.0 (PKL-V1), and ZeroScope (ZS).
paragraphs.zh: EvalCrafter [ 33 ]：包含 14 个视频生成器子集，即 VideoCrafter V0.9（Floor33）、MoonValley（MV）、Gen2、Gen2-December（Gen2-D）、Mix-SR、HotShot-XL（HS-XL）、Show-1、ModelScope（MS）、LaVie-Base（LaVie-B）、LaVie-Interpolation（LaVie-I）、PikaLab（PKL）、VideoCrafter（VC）、PikaLab V1.0（PKL-V1）和 ZeroScope（ZS）。

paragraphs.en: VideoPhy [ 34 ] : Incorporates 10 specialized subsets tailored for evaluating physical world dynamics and spatiotemporal consistency, which are synthesized by CogVideoX (CVX), CogVideoX-5B (CVX-5B), Dream-Machine (DM), Gen2, LaVie, OpenSora, Pika, SVD-T2I2V, VideoCrafter2 (VC2), and ZeroScope (ZS).
paragraphs.zh: VideoPhy [ 34 ]：整合了 10 个专门用于评估物理世界动态与时空一致性的子集，这些子集由 CogVideoX (CVX)、CogVideoX-5B (CVX-5B)、Dream-Machine (DM)、Gen2、LaVie、OpenSora、Pika、SVD-T2I2V、VideoCrafter2 (VC2) 和 ZeroScope (ZS) 合成。

paragraphs.en: VidProM [ 35 ] : Encompasses 6 distinct text-to-video generation tracks derived from diverse real-world user prompts, including ModelScope (MS), OpenSora, Pika, StreamingT2V (ST2V), Text2Video-Zero (T2VZ), and VideoCrafter2 (VC2).

paragraphs.en: To comprehensively evaluate the performance of the proposed MTOR, we compare it against 16 representative baselines, consisting of 2 image-level detectors and 14 video-level frameworks. According to their target domains and foundational paradigms, the video-level detectors are rigorously partitioned into three primary categories: (i) deepfake video detection methods, including STIL, FTCN, TALL, and MINTIME; (ii) AI-generated video detection frameworks, which include learning-based networks such as AIGVDet, DeMamba, DeCoF, and NSG-VD, alongside training-free detection models such as ReStraV, D3, and STALL; and (iii) cross-domain adapted approaches, including STPAG and LGN-Net from the video anomaly detection domain, as well as X-CLIP from the general video recognition domain, all adjusted with a binary head for synthetic video classification. A concise conceptual overview of each baseline is detailed below:
paragraphs.zh: 为了全面评估所提出的 MTOR 的性能，我们将其与 16 个具有代表性的基线模型进行了比较，这些基线模型包括 2 个图像级检测器和 14 个视频级框架。 根据它们的目标域和基础范式，视频级探测器被严格划分为三大类：(i) 深度伪造视频检测方法，包括 STIL、FTCN、TALL 和 MINTIME；(ii) AI 生成视频检测框架，其中包括基于学习的网络（如 AIGVDet、DeMamba、DeCoF 和 NSG-VD），以及无需训练的检测模型（如 ReStraV、D3 和 STALL）；以及 (iii) 跨域自适应方法，包括来自视频异常检测领域的 STPAG 和 LGN-Net，以及来自通用视频识别领域的 X-CLIP，这些方法均通过添加用于合成视频分类的二元头进行了调整。 以下是对每个基线模型的简要概念性概述：

sents.zh: 为了全面评估所提出的 MTOR 的性能，我们将其与 16 个具有代表性的基线模型进行了比较，这些基线模型包括 2 个图像级检测器和 14 个视频级框架。

sents.en: According to their target domains and foundational paradigms, the video-level detectors are rigorously partitioned into three primary categories: (i) deepfake video detection methods, including STIL, FTCN, TALL, and MINTIME; (ii) AI-generated video detection frameworks, which include learning-based networks such as AIGVDet, DeMamba, DeCoF, and NSG-VD, alongside training-free detection models such as ReStraV, D3, and STALL; and (iii) cross-domain adapted approaches, including STPAG and LGN-Net from the video anomaly detection domain, as well as X-CLIP from the general video recognition domain, all adjusted with a binary head for synthetic video classification.
sents.zh: 根据它们的目标域和基础范式，视频级探测器被严格划分为三大类：(i) 深度伪造视频检测方法，包括 STIL、FTCN、TALL 和 MINTIME；(ii) AI 生成视频检测框架，其中包括基于学习的网络（如 AIGVDet、DeMamba、DeCoF 和 NSG-VD），以及无需训练的检测模型（如 ReStraV、D3 和 STALL）；以及 (iii) 跨域自适应方法，包括来自视频异常检测领域的 STPAG 和 LGN-Net，以及来自通用视频识别领域的 X-CLIP，这些方法均通过添加用于合成视频分类的二元头进行了调整。

sents.en: A concise conceptual overview of each baseline is detailed below:
sents.zh: 以下是对每个基线模型的简要概念性概述：

paragraphs.en: FID [ 51 ] : Leverages a patch-shuffle mechanism to eliminate semantic artifacts for AI-generated image detection, extending to video detection by temporal average pooling.
paragraphs.zh: FID [ 51 ]：利用一种块打乱机制来消除人工智能生成图像检测中的语义伪影，并通过时间平均池化将其扩展至视频检测。

paragraphs.en: NPR [ 52 ] : Targets CNN-specific up-sampling artifacts to expose AI-generated images, with video-level predictions aggregated via temporal pooling strategy.
paragraphs.zh: NPR [ 52 ] : 针对 CNN 特有的上采样伪影，以揭示 AI 生成的图像，并通过时间池化策略聚合视频级预测结果。

paragraphs.en: STIL [ 18 ] : Capitalizes on a spatiotemporal inconsistency learning block to capture multi-directional temporal dynamics and spatial artifacts across frames.
paragraphs.zh: STIL [ 18 ]：利用时空不一致性学习模块，捕捉跨帧的多方向时间动态和空间伪影。

paragraphs.en: FTCN [ 19 ] : Utilizes 1 × 1 1\times 1 spatial convolutions and a Transformer to capture both short- and long-term temporal coherence for general face forgery detection.
paragraphs.zh: FTCN [ 19 ]：采用 1×1 空间卷积和 Transformer，以捕捉短期和长期时间连贯性，从而实现通用的面部伪造检测。

paragraphs.en: TALL [ 22 ] : Rearranges consecutive frames into a pre-defined thumbnail layout to efficiently capture spatiotemporal dependencies using model-agnostic backbones.
paragraphs.zh: TALL [ 22 ]：将连续帧重新排列成预定义的小图布局，利用与模型无关的骨干网络高效捕捉时空依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: MINTIME [ 23 ] : Performs multi-identity deepfake detection by capturing spatiotemporal inconsistencies across identities and encoding face-scale contextual cues.
paragraphs.zh: MINTIME [ 23 ]：通过捕捉不同身份之间的时空不一致性，并编码面部尺度上下文线索，实现多身份深度伪造检测。

paragraphs.en: AIGVDet [ 31 ] : Detects AI-generated videos via a two-branch framework capturing spatial anomalies in RGB frames and temporal patterns in optical flow.
paragraphs.zh: AIGVDet [ 31 ]：通过一个双分支框架检测人工智能生成的视频，该框架能够捕捉 RGB 帧中的空间异常和光流中的时间模式。

paragraphs.en: DeMamba [ 32 ] : Leverages a Mamba-based network to efficiently process long-range, frame-wise temporal dependencies for synthetic video detection.
paragraphs.zh: DeMamba [ 32 ]：利用基于 Mamba 的网络，高效处理合成视频检测中的长距离、逐帧时间依赖关系。

paragraphs.en: DeCoF [ 59 ] : Identifies AI-generated videos by modeling inter-frame consistency in the visual feature space to capture temporal artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: DeCoF [ 59 ]：通过建模视觉特征空间中的帧间一致性来捕捉时间上的伪影，从而识别由人工智能生成的视频。

paragraphs.en: NSG-VD [ 16 ] : Exposes AI-generated videos by computing a Normalized Spatiotemporal Gradient based on probability flow conservation, and leveraging Maximum Mean Discrepancy to detect physical dynamics deviations.
paragraphs.zh: NSG-VD [ 16 ]：通过基于概率流守恒计算归一化时空梯度，并利用最大均值差异来检测物理动态偏差，从而揭示人工智能生成的视频。

paragraphs.en: ReStraV [ 14 ] : Uncovers AI-generated videos via perceptual straightening in representation space, using temporal curvature and stepwise distance.
paragraphs.zh: ReStraV [ 14 ]：通过在表示空间中利用时间曲率和分步距离进行感知性矫正，检测出由人工智能生成的视频。

paragraphs.en: D3 [ 15 ] : Discriminates AI-generated videos via a training-free framework by computing second-order central difference features to capture temporal artifacts.
paragraphs.zh: D3 [ 15 ]：通过计算二阶中心差分特征以捕捉时间维度的伪影，从而无需训练即可区分人工智能生成的视频。

paragraphs.en: STALL [ 17 ] : Introduces a training-free paradigm that distinguishes AI-generated videos from real ones by combining separate spatial and temporal likelihood scores into a joint probabilistic framework.
paragraphs.zh: STALL [ 17 ]：提出了一种无需训练的范式，通过将独立的空间和时序似然分数整合到一个联合概率框架中，来区分人工智能生成的视频与真实视频。

paragraphs.en: STPAG [ 53 ] : Detects AI-generated videos by adapting an anomaly detection framework that captures generative artifacts via diffusion models and optical perturbations.
paragraphs.zh: STPAG [ 53 ]：通过采用一种异常检测框架来检测人工智能生成的视频，该框架利用扩散模型和光学扰动捕捉生成过程中的伪影。

paragraphs.en: LGN-Net [ 54 ] : Exposes generative artifacts by adapting a memory-augmented, local-global spatiotemporal anomaly detection framework for AI-generated video detection.
paragraphs.zh: LGN-Net [ 54 ]：通过为人工智能生成的视频检测适配一种增强记忆能力的局部-全局时空异常检测框架，从而揭示生成性人工产物。

paragraphs.en: X-CLIP [ 55 ] : Employs a frozen, cross-frame attention-based spatiotemporal backbone coupled with a binary classifier to distinguish synthetic videos.
paragraphs.zh: X-CLIP [ 55 ]：采用一个冻结的、基于跨帧注意力的时空主干网络，并结合一个二元分类器来区分合成视频。

paragraphs.en: To ensure a rigorous and fair comparison, all baselines and our MTOR are evaluated under identical dataset splits and unified training and testing protocols.
paragraphs.zh: 为确保比较的严谨性和公平性，所有基线模型以及我们的 MTOR 均在相同的数据集划分和统一的训练与测试协议下进行评估。

paragraphs.en: Following prior state-of-the-art methods, such as ReStraV [ 14 ] , NSG-VD [ 16 ] , DeMamba [ 32 ] , and DeCoF [ 13 ] , we adopt three widely used metrics to evaluate our approach: Average Precision (AP), Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUC), and Accuracy (ACC). AP evaluates the precision-recall trade-off via the area under the precision-recall curve, reflecting the model’s ability to precisely rank synthetic videos. AUC quantifies the overall detection capability across all possible thresholds, representing the probability that a randomly chosen AI-generated video is scored higher than a real one. ACC measures the proportion of correctly classified real and AI-generated videos. Throughout Tables III – XIX , bold and underlined values denote the best and second-best results within each column, respectively.
paragraphs.zh: 遵循此前最先进的研究方法，例如 ReStraV [ 14 ]、NSG-VD [ 16 ]、DeMamba [ 32 ] 和 DeCoF [ 13 ]，我们采用三种广泛使用的指标来评估我们的方法：平均精度（AP）、受试者工作特征曲线下面积（AUC）以及准确率（ACC）。 AP 通过精确率-召回率曲线下的面积来评估精确率与召回率之间的权衡，反映了模型精准排序合成视频的能力。 AUC 量化了所有可能阈值下的整体检测能力，表示随机选择的 AI 生成视频被赋予更高评分的概率。 ACC 衡量正确分类真实视频和 AI 生成视频的比例。 在表 III – XIX 中，粗体且带下划线的值分别表示每列中的最佳结果和次佳结果。

The quantitative results in terms of AP, AUC, and ACC are summarized in Tables III – XIII . For baselines with officially released code, we reproduce their results using the official implementations. For methods without official implementations, we carefully re-implement them following the experimental settings in the original papers.

paragraphs.en: Tables III and IV compare MTOR with 16 baseline methods on GenVideo in terms of AP and AUC, respectively, while Table XIII reports the corresponding ACC results. MTOR achieves the highest mean AP, AUC, and ACC of 98.74%, 98.64%, and 93.36%, respectively. Specifically, MTOR surpasses the strongest baseline D3 by 6.58 percentage points in mean AP. In terms of mean AUC, our approach exceeds the second-best competitor ReStraV by 6.15 percentage points. Furthermore, MTOR outperforms the closest competitor DeCoF by 5.76 percentage points in ACC.
paragraphs.zh: 表 III 和表 IV 分别比较了 MTOR 与 16 种基线方法在 GenVideo 数据集上的 AP 和 AUC，而表 XIII 报告了相应的 ACC 结果。 MTOR 实现了最高的平均 AP、AUC 和 ACC，分别为 98.74%、98.64% 和 93.36%。 具体而言，MTOR 在平均 AP 上比最强的基线方法 D3 高出 6.58 个百分点。 在平均 AUC 方面，我们的方法比第二强的竞争者 ReStraV 高出 6.15 个百分点。 此外，MTOR 在 ACC 上比最接近的竞争者 DeCoF 高出 5.76 个百分点。

paragraphs.en: The baseline methods exhibit substantial performance variations across different generator subsets. Deepfake detectors, originally developed for facial manipulation, generally show limited transferability to open-domain AI-generated videos on GenVideo. Image-level detectors remain competitive on certain generators, but their performance varies considerably across subsets. paragraphs.en: We conduct two sets of ablation studies to examine the key design choices of MTOR. 1) We evaluate the contributions of visual and textual representations, their multimodal combination, and the TOR component across all five benchmarks, with the results reported in Tables XIV – XVI . 2) We investigate different combinations of captioning models and visual-textual encoders on GenVideo, as reported in Tables XVII – XIX .
paragraphs.zh: 我们进行了两组消融研究，以考察 MTOR 的关键设计选择。1）我们在全部五个基准数据集上评估了视觉和文本表示、其多模态组合以及 TOR 组件的贡献，结果见表 XIV–XVI。2）我们研究了在 GenVideo 上不同的图像描述模型与视觉-文本编码器的组合，结果见表 XVII–XIX。

paragraphs.en: Tables XIV – XVI compare five variants: visual-only, text-only, the multimodal branch G G , the TOR-only variant, and the complete MTOR. The visual-only variant achieves five-benchmark mean AP, AUC, and ACC of 94.78%, 94.25%, and 87.35%, respectively, outperforming the text-only variant in overall mean performance. Combining the global visual and caption-derived textual representations in the multimodal branch G G substantially improves the mean performance to 97.26% AP, 97.17% AUC, and 89.51% ACC. Compared with the visual-only variant, these correspond to gains of 2.48, 2.92, and 2.16 percentage points. paragraphs.en: To investigate the effects of caption generation and visual-textual representation on detection performance, we evaluate different combinations of captioning models and visual-textual encoders on GenVideo. The image-level captioners include “BLIP-base” and “BLIP-large”, which generate descriptions for individual frames and are paired with CLIP-P16, CLIP-P32, XCLIP-P16, and XCLIP-P32. The video-level captioners include “CogVLM2-Caption”, “UGC-VideoCaptioner”, and “ShareGPT4Video-8B”, which generate video-level descriptions and are paired with “LanguageBind” or “InternVideo 2.5”. Tables XVII – XIX report the corresponding AP, AUC, and ACC results.
paragraphs.zh: 为了研究字幕生成与视觉-文本表示对检测性能的影响，我们在 GenVideo 上评估了不同组合的字幕模型和视觉-文本编码器。 图像级字幕生成器包括“BLIP-base”和“BLIP-large”，它们为单个帧生成描述，并与 CLIP-P16、CLIP-P32、XCLIP-P16 和 XCLIP-P32 搭配使用。 视频级字幕生成器包括“CogVLM2-Caption”、“UGC-VideoCaptioner”和“ShareGPT4Video-8B”，它们生成视频级描述，并与“LanguageBind”或“InternVideo 2.5”搭配使用。 表格 XVII – XIX 报告了相应的 AP、AUC 和 ACC 结果。

paragraphs.en: Overall, configurations using video-level captioners and video-language encoders achieve higher mean performance than those using frame-level BLIP captioners with CLIP/XCLIP encoders. For each video-level captioner, “InternVideo 2.5” consistently outperforms “LanguageBind” across all three metrics. The improvements range from 1.45 to 4.04 percentage points in AP, 1.52 to 3.69 percentage points in AUC, and 2.86 to 7.16 percentage points in ACC. These results indicate that the choice of visual-textual encoder has a substantial effect on detection performance. In addition, “BLIP-large” does not consistently outperform “BLIP-base” under the same encoder, suggesting that increasing the captioning model size alone does not necessarily improve detection performance.
paragraphs.zh: 总体而言，使用视频级描述生成器和视频-语言编码器的配置所实现的平均性能高于使用帧级 BLIP 描述生成器与 CLIP/XCLIP 编码器的配置。 对于每种视频级描述生成器，“InternVideo 2.5”在所有三项指标上的表现均持续优于“LanguageBind”。 改进幅度在 AP 上为 1.45 至 4.04 个百分点，在 AUC 上为 1.52 至 3.69 个百分点，在 ACC 上为 2.86 至 7.16 个百分点。 这些结果表明，视觉-文本编码器的选择对检测性能有显著影响。 此外，在使用相同编码器时，“BLIP-large”并未持续优于“BLIP-base”，这表明仅通过增大描述生成模型的大小并不一定能提升检测性能。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we further analyze the discriminative characteristics and practical robustness of MTOR. Specifically, we employ t-SNE to visualize the distribution of real and AI-generated videos across the 10 generator subsets of GenVideo, providing an intuitive comparison of their separability in the representation space. We then compare MTOR with four representative baselines under 12 practical video perturbations, covering codec compression, resolution and frame-rate changes, color-space transformation, social-media simulation, and TikTok-style post-processing.

paragraphs.en: In this paper, we proposed MTOR for generalizable AI-generated video detection by jointly considering video-level multimodal semantics and temporal over-regularity. The multimodal branch represented each video from both visual and caption-derived semantic perspectives, while retaining the video itself as the sole input. Our temporal analysis further revealed that AI-generated videos tended to exhibit stronger temporal persistence and reduced temporal variability, which we termed temporal over-regularity. To quantify this temporal pattern, we developed the TOR component with six descriptors characterizing coarse inter-frame continuity, fine-grained token correspondence, and frame-to-video stability. The predictions from the two branches were combined through source-calibrated score fusion using only source-domain statistics. Across five large-scale benchmarks and 46 generator variants, comparisons with 16 representative baselines demonstrated the state-of-the-art overall performance of MTOR. Additional ablation studies confirmed the complementary contributions of the multimodal branch and TOR component, while robustness experiments showed consistently strong performance across twelve diverse video perturbations. Overall, these results established MTOR as an effective and robust framework for cross-generator AI-generated video detection.
paragraphs.zh: 在本文中，我们提出了 MTOR，通过联合考虑视频级的多模态语义和时序过度规则性，实现了可泛化的 AI 生成视频检测。 多模态分支从视觉和文本描述衍生的语义两个角度表示每个视频，同时仅保留视频本身作为输入。 我们的时序分析进一步揭示，AI 生成的视频倾向于表现出更强的时序持续性和更低的时序变异性，我们将此现象称为“时序过度规则性”。 为了量化这种时序模式，我们开发了 TOR 组件，其中包含六个描述符，分别刻画了粗略的帧间连续性、细粒度的词元对应关系以及帧到视频的稳定性。 两个分支的预测结果通过仅使用源域统计信息进行的源校准分数融合进行整合。 在五个大规模基准数据集和 46 种生成器变体上，与 16 个代表性基线方法的对比表明，MTOR 实现了当前最先进的整体性能。 额外的消融研究证实了多模态分支和 TOR 组件的互补性贡献，而鲁棒性实验则显示该方法在十二种不同的视频扰动下均表现出稳定且强劲的性能。 总体而言，这些结果确立了 MTOR 作为跨生成器 AI 生成视频检测的有效且稳健的框架。
